title: devexp-standup-2026-05-13
content:
DevEx Standup - 2026-05-13
Attendees: Ava (owner), Samir, Priya, Diego, Maya, + async notes from Jin

1) High level updates
- SDK 0.9.0-beta branch: feature freeze reached yesterday. Samir: all major features merged; running full integration test suite this afternoon. Notable: streaming helper API now returns a single async iterator for chat + function calling.
- Quickstart docs revamp: Priya finished first pass of step-by-step using the new hosted API examples and simplified auth flow. Uploaded draft to Confluence (linked). Need one more pass for Windows/PowerShell commands.
- Sample app (todo-lists demo): Diego integrated new SDK auth and streaming; local dev flow working, but CI flake on mac-latest image failing intermittently.
- Snippets & copy edits: Maya is updating copy for code snippets to ensure 80-char line length and add better error handling examples.

2) Blockers / Risks
- CI flake (mac-latest) for sample app prevents green build for the demo repo -> blocks release candidate publish. Action: Diego to triage with infra (RDW-2180) today; if not fixed by EOD Friday, we'll cut a release without the demo and follow-up patch.
- Token-mismatch error occasionally seen in streaming tests after reconnects. Samir suspects race in reconnection logic; adding deterministic unit tests to reproduce.
- Quickstart Windows shell commands: Priya needs help verifying PowerShell steps on Windows VM. Maya offered to run through locally but needs VM creds. Action: Ava to request VM from infra.

3) Metrics / Signals
- Docs metrics (alpha telemetry): quickstart page time-on-page up 12% after copy changes; completion rate (clicked "Run locally") at 34% (goal 45%).
- SDK integration tests: 382/400 passing on CI (most failures are transient network/timeouts). Aim to hit 400/400 before cutting RC.

4) Decisions made
- Cut RC 0.9.0-rc1 Friday EOD if integration tests are >= 395/400 and mac CI flake is resolved. Otherwise, postpone RC by one day and publish a transparency note on the internal release slack channel.
- Defer Windows Quickstart polish to next sprint if VM verification can't be completed this week; publish initial quickstart with a clear note about PowerShell differences.

5) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Samir: finish integration test triage + add reconnection deterministic tests (due 2026-05-14).
- Diego: triage mac-latest CI flake with infra and open a follow-up issue if root cause not found (RDW-2180) (due 2026-05-13 EOD).
- Priya: finalize quickstart draft and add PowerShell appendix; add screenshots for SDK setup (due 2026-05-15).
- Maya: bulk edit code snippets for consistency and run spellcheck pass on quickstart (due 2026-05-14).
- Ava: request Windows VM access from infra and post status in #devex (due 2026-05-13).
- Jin (async): provide sample app user-flow notes and UX pain points by 2026-05-14.

6) Notes / Discussion items
- We discussed adding a small "playground" container for the quickstart so users can try the demo without local setup. Cost estimate: small, but needs infra approval. Diego to draft a lightweight infra request.
- Consider adding a short troubleshooting section in the quickstart for common streaming/connectivity issues (Samir to outline).
- We should decide on the RC tag naming scheme for public releases; proposed: 0.9.0-rc1 -> release/0.9.0-rc1 (consistent with existing gitflow). Consensus: ok.

7) Parking lot / future work
- Offline-first examples for Private deployments (migrating quickstart flows to VPC context).
- Embeddings quickstart: create a separate mini-quickstart focused on embeddings + similarity search.
- Workshop: developer office hours next month to walk through new quickstarts and SDK changes.

8) Next standup
- 2026-05-20, 10:00 PDT (recurring).

Attached links: Confluence quickstart draft, RDW-2145 (SDK task list), RDW-2180 (CI flake), PR #456 (streaming helper), docs commit 8f3a2b.

Notes: informal meeting notes, actionable items above. Will update Confluence page once Quickstart final pass complete.
